t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes fall into 2 groups - green/blue/orange/yellow and pink/purple/brown/red. They are either high or low value as a group and this changes through the game

vb_textbox.text: There are 2 groups of gnomes: GBOY and PPRB These correlate to Green, Blue, Orange, Yellow; and Pink, Purple, Red, Brown.At any time these groups will have a high or low value of mushrooms. If you find one group is scoring high, stick with this group. Values can change over time within the game. If the group starts to score low, skip to the other group!Both groups can be low scoring at once / high scoring at once too. Just stick with the best one until it starts to change!
